name: Blueprint

test_list.description: Create a digest-pinned blueprint, serialize and parse it, then reject content tampering.
Reject mutable image tags and malformed policy references.
Reject unknown/non-canonical driver values and refuse Docker/VM backend mismatches before creation.
Require KVM only for VM plans, choose matching driver actions and provide a postcondition for every step.
Preserve unknown host probes while treating KVM as optional for Docker and required for VM.
Build the guest from the allowlisted context and install it under /usr/bin where the sandbox policy permits execution.

inputs.name: blueprint
inputs.description: Versioned image and policy blueprint with a canonical BLAKE3 digest.

inputs.name: backend
inputs.description: OpenShell backend exposing the driver identity authenticated from its gateway connection.

inputs.name: probes
inputs.description: Observed host facts from the platform probe layer.

output_description: An applied sandbox only after digest verification, selected-driver match, and guest protocol handshake.
